sources.title: Dirisa Sdc |
sources.snippet: The DIRISA student datathon is a competition that is organised by the Data Intensive Research Initiative of South Africa (DIRISA) to showcase how open research data can be used to come up with creative and innovative solutions to some of South Africa's problems.

sources.title: DIRISA - Data Intensive Research Initiative of South Africa
sources.snippet: The Data Intensive Research Initiative of South Africa (DIRISA) promotes, enables, and coordinates a data intensive research ecosystem in support of national science and strategic priorities.
